name: shoot.edit
description: Changes a shoot's title, day, hours or place. Hours follow the call sheet's rules: a new start keeps the length, and an end at or before the start becomes an hour after it.
sql:
update brandbase.shoots s set
  title = coalesce(btrim(:title), s.title), day = coalesce(:day::date, s.day), place = coalesce(:place, s.place),
  start = (brandbase.hours_after(s.start, s."end", :start, :end))[1],
  "end" = (brandbase.hours_after(s.start, s."end", :start, :end))[2],
  version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
returning brandbase.shoot_json(s) as result
